title: Missile strike in Bab el-Mandeb: Maersk and ZIM suspend all Red Sea maritime transit indefinitely
text: A.P. Moller - Maersk and ZIM Integrated Shipping ordered an immediate halt to all commercial container transits through the southern Red Sea after a commercial vessel was struck by an anti-ship missile. All vessels are rerouted via South Africa's Cape of Good Hope, adding 10 to 14 days to Asia-Europe voyage times and causing container freight spot rates to surge 45% overnight.

title: Citigroup placed on negative credit watch over $4.8B distressed sovereign counterparty debt exposure

title: US FTC and European Commission launch joint antitrust probe into NVIDIA AI server packaging covenants

title: OPEC+ emergency meeting confirms surprise 1.8M bpd production cut; Brent crude spikes 6.8%
text: OPEC+ energy ministers concluded an unscheduled virtual conference by approving an immediate 1.8 million barrel-per-day production cut through the coming quarter.
